business_problem: unify a fractured analytics landscape created by acquisitions so teams across subsidiaries could work from shared definitions, faster pipelines, and lower-cost models.
solution_summary: PayU GPO uses Snowflake, dbt, Tableau, Airflow, and Dynamic Tables to unify analytics across a federated payments business built through acquisitions. More than 800 pipelines funnel subsidiary data into Snowflake, where the central team standardizes terminology, global metrics, certified reports, and shared data models without forcing every local team to abandon its preferred tools or languages. dbt, Tableau, Airflow, REST APIs, Java, and Python workflows continue to operate around the Snowflake core, while Dynamic Tables and architectural tuning recommended by Snowflake reduce refresh overhead for selected models. The platform gives roughly 350 active users a shared view of operations, faster ingestion, fresher calculations, and materially lower run costs, creating a more scalable operating model for company-wide insight.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized analytics core for subsidiary data, shared definitions, and certified reporting.

solution_components.name: dbt
solution_components.role: Builds global models and metrics on top of the unified Snowflake data foundation.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Surfaces certified dashboards and reporting views for business and operations users.

solution_components.name: Airflow
solution_components.role: Orchestrates data workflows that feed the Snowflake-based analytics environment.

solution_components.name: Dynamic Tables
solution_components.role: Optimizes recurring model refreshes and lowers processing overhead for selected workloads.

data_flow: Subsidiary data is funneled into Snowflake through hundreds of pipelines, then standardized through shared models and terminology. Orchestrated workflows and Dynamic Tables keep the data fresh, and curated outputs are served through dashboards and reports to business, marketing, sales, and operations teams.
business_outcome: PayU GPO improved data ingestion by 83%, lowered selected model costs by as much as 94%, reduced total cost of ownership, and created a shared data language across the company.
